name: Summer at the Edge of the Universe
source:
Take to the stars with Summer Nansen and her friends on an intergalactic adventure to the very boundaries of existence!

After drifting apart for several years, a chance encounter brings four best friends back together for the journey of a lifetime. For Summer Nansen (CV: Angel Haven Rey), this trip is not only a chance to rekindle old friendships, but also to discover what it is she wants out of life. Alongside a new robot friend named Curiosity, the four friends travel from planet to planet, exploring the natural wonders and diverse alien cultures that they come across. Their journey culminates at the borderline of existence itself: the very edge of the universe.

Summer at the Edge of the Universe contains two routes with romantic endings and one route with a platonic ending. Each route takes the gang to 4 different planets, meeting the locals and making memories that will last for a lifetime.

[From [url=https://vnstudioelan.com/games/summer/]official website[/url]]
translation:
与萨默·南森和她的朋友们一起踏上星际冒险之旅，探索存在的边界！

疏散多年后，一次偶然的邂逅让四个最好的朋友重新走到一起，踏上一生的旅程。对于萨默·南森（CV：Angel Haven Rey）来说，这次旅行不仅是重燃旧友谊的机会，也是发现她想要从生活中得到什么的机会。四个朋友与一个名叫好奇号的新机器人朋友一起从一个星球旅行到另一个星球，探索他们遇到的自然奇观和多样化的外星文化。他们的旅程在存在本身的边界达到顶峰：宇宙的边缘。

《宇宙边缘的夏天》包含两条具有浪漫结局的路线和一条具有柏拉图式结局的路线。每条路线都会带领大家前往4个不同的星球，与当地人见面并留下终生难忘的回忆。

[来自[url=https://vnstudioelan.com/games/summer/]官网[/url]]
